I keep on failing people. But that doesn't mean I'm forever a failure. Every time I feel like I'm a disappointment, I read some of the tweets I've posted here to remind myself that difficult times happen 'cause there's always room for me to grow as a person. :) Focus on the now.

Why does it hurt so bad when you get sucked into an argument by someone you love? I'm really baffled whenever I'm unable to control my anger to a point that I just want to explode. Bottled feelings eh?

The longer I stay in med, the more I realize how mediocre, dispensable and outcast I am. Maybe this is the reason why I feel like my path is dark and rocky atm, why I don't have the urge to just push more. My environment suffocates my entirety. A support system is all I need.

I'm looked down on by the very few people I get to see daily in med school. I wish people aren't like this to me. I feel like my energy is drained; they don't like me. And I don't talk back nor assert myself. I'm part of this group too. I just want another chance in life.

To every med student out there who's anxious abt whether or not you'd be able to do great in the hospital, relax. You'll be ok. We go through that stage where we just don't know what we're capable of. But I assure you, when you meet your first patient, you'll do just fine. 😊

I feel so cold. Payakap.

Please don't hurt me. I can't take too much more. I've been through a lot. I won't let my guard down anymore.

I almost lost my cool kanina seeing how slow the day has been esp. considering that I'm From/Postduty. My patience was really tested. Sleep-deprivation really makes me groggy and irritable. God knows kaunting usog na lang sasabog nako. 😆 Buti, ughhh, di ako naging monster. 😪😩

I know I look strong and unyielding on the outside, but please, don't hurt me so, so bad Future Mahal. Everyday, I struggle to suppress all the bad things I've heard from people I loved so much. I'm like a puppy chronically 'kicked' and verbally abused by my owners. Keep me. 😔
